title: NaN trade prices must not be filled
summary: NaN trade prices (halt / missing bar) must not be filled with 1; skip that symbol on that bar.
narrative: NaN trade prices (halt / missing bar) must not be filled with 1. The engine should not trade that symbol on that bar; fees stay 0. NaN on one symbol must not poison other symbols' total_value (use nansum).
python_code:
import numpy as np
# Do not fill NaN trade prices with 1.
# Skip that symbol on this bar; fees stay 0.
# Use nansum so one NaN does not poison other symbols' total_value.
print(np.nansum([1.0, np.nan, 2.0]))
